why: In section 1, the reader works out the amount paid in themselves (10,000 + 120 × 500 = 70,000 ₪) and says "The page never shows me the 70,000 figure." Section 6 repeats it: "How much I put in altogether, next to how much I'd have. I want to see 70,000 against 86,045." This is a direct statement that the headline result has no reference point. The only earlier complaint was the missing box for the number of years.
